sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, absolute x/y centroid, fill colour) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/celebrity/celebrity-solstice/v2455/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg, current version resolved via the deckmaps in-app network log). One .cabinShape element (rect/polygon/polyline/path) per stateroom; the stateroom number comes from each element's id ("R<num>", with data-cabin as fallback). Rect centroids from x+w/2,y+h/2; polygon/polyline centroids from the mean of points; path centroids computed by fully resolving relative SVG path commands to absolute anchor points and averaging. Category legend built by matching each fill colour to a Celebrity stateroom category using the fleet-wide Celebrity colour convention (same palette verified against the Celebrity Edge and Celebrity Millennium deck SVGs from this site) and cross-checked against cruisedeckplans.com Celebrity-Solstice per-category counts: Ocean View (70), Veranda (716), Sunset Veranda (24), Family Veranda (4), Sky Suite (44), Celebrity Suite (12), Royal Suite (8), Penthouse Suite (2) and Panoramic Infinite Veranda Suite (17) match the cruisedeckplans counts exactly.

notes.completeness: FULL grid of every numbered stateroom deckmaps draws for the revamped Celebrity Solstice: decks 3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12,15. 1480 unique stateroom numbers, zero duplicates (no cabin number appears on more than one deck). Every number, position and colour comes straight from the deckmaps v2455 SVGs; nothing was invented. Celebrity Solstice was refurbished ('Solstice-ization', ~54 staterooms added) and now has ~1,479 staterooms (cruiseline sources); the 1480 drawn cabinShapes match this almost exactly. NOTE: deckmaps' own versions.json lists cabin_count=683 for v2455 - that figure counts only the cabins carrying a full data-cabin metadata attribute (a subset); the SVGs actually draw 1480 numbered cabin shapes, which is the complete grid captured here. Decks 2,4,5,14,16 carry no numbered staterooms in the source (theatre/dining/pool/Lawn Club/public); deck 15 is the refurb's new top suite deck.
notes.category: deckmaps encodes category only via cabin fill colour. 30 distinct fills map to 14 Celebrity Solstice categories (most categories use several colour shades for sub-blocks / service tiers). See colorLegend. Count cross-check vs cruisedeckplans.com: Ocean View 70=70, Veranda 716=716, Sunset Veranda 24=24, Family Veranda 4=4, Sky Suite 44=44, Celebrity Suite 12=12, Royal Suite 8=8, Penthouse Suite 2=2, Panoramic Infinite Veranda Suite 17=17 (all exact). Divergences: this file's Interior=155 vs cruisedeckplans 140, AquaClass=146 vs 130, Concierge Class=266 vs 275 - Concierge and AquaClass are service tiers physically built on Veranda/Ocean-View cabins and the colour-coded split does not exactly equal the sold-inventory counts (the same divergence seen on Celebrity Millennium); the colour-coded value is used here. Panoramic Oceanview Suite (#00b6b5, 8) matches exactly; Panoramic Oceanview Stateroom (#c7c8ca + #47b74e, 8) is short of the cruisedeckplans 10 - the 8 handful of forward-facing panoramic cabins on decks 11/15 are the lowest-confidence assignments.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. Bow confirmed at the low-y end on every deck (low cabin numbers sit at low y; verified deck-by-deck). section = forward/mid/aft thirds of the ship length, using a single global y-range shared by the full-length decks 6-11 (the SVGs share one y coordinate system; only x is offset per deck) so partial decks (3,12,15) are classified consistently. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED then ANCHORED to the Celebrity numbering convention. Even cabin numbers sit on the higher-x beam row and odd on the lower-x row, cleanly on every deck (verified on deck 7: even avg x 981 vs odd 939); with the bow at low y (viewed from above, bow up) higher x is starboard, so side = starboard for even numbers, port for odd - the same convention anchored on Celebrity Edge (cabin 6218 even = starboard). x is offset per deck so parity, not absolute x, drives the side. Could be uniformly mirrored on a specific deck; validate against a known cabin before relying on it.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps SVGs carry no obstructed-view flag; obstructed=false for all (source does not encode obstruction; NOT an assertion of guaranteed clear view). Celebrity Solstice does have some obstructed / lifeboat-view cabins (many on deck 6/7) - a separate research layer.
